reading.summary: Databricks Machine Learning certifications validate skills in using Databricks Machine Learning for machine learning and generative AI tasks. They include associate and professional levels for machine learning, plus associate certifications for generative AI engineering and context engineering. Earning a credential shows ability to develop, deploy, test, and maintain ML models and pipelines, and to build generative AI solutions and AI agent systems on Databricks.
reading.audience: Machine learning engineers and others who develop, deploy, test, and maintain machine learning models and pipelines, or who design and build generative AI and AI agent systems using Databricks.
